_readme: Copy this file to .image-fixtures/manifest.json and put the referenced JPGs alongside it (gitignored). 'catalog' = the inventory products the verifier can choose from (include the CORRECT product for each case + its colour-distinct lookalikes). 'cases' = labelled customer photos with the product they SHOULD match. Then run: RUN_IMAGE_ACCURACY=1 GEMINI_API_KEY=... IMAGE_VERIFY_WITH_AI=true IMAGE_SEGMENTATION_ENABLED=true npx vitest run src/ai/imageAccuracy.test.ts

cases.note: white cottan w/ black floral embroidery — must NOT resolve to teal crape
white soft-organza w/ pink florals — must NOT resolve to mint mul
